proposed.text: Which publicity practice is prohibited by Section 1-d?

options.text: Paid advertisement or self-laudatory, exaggerated, or misleading publicity
Factual material that advances public knowledge of the architect's function
Educational material about the profession's aims and standards
Public communication that dignifies the profession

proposed.rationale: Section 1-d prohibits paid advertisement and self-laudatory, exaggerated, or misleading publicity while allowing factual public information that dignifies or explains the profession.
